rule.description: the id of the rule of the warning

lines.description: only for a warning about these lines; every line when not given

Acknowledgement.description: Acknowledgement says a warning of a rule on this document is expected, so it is not shown as one.

name.description: Name is unique within the kind, and is how refs and logs name the document.

refs.description:
Refs holds every reference to another document: names only, and the key
says which kind the name is of.

acknowledge.description: Acknowledge says which warnings of this document are expected, and why.

Artifact.description: Artifact is one thing each release of a stream produces.

ArtifactPins.description: ArtifactPins is what a pin reads: the file of the pinning release that says which version of each pinned Artifact goes with it.

name.description: an image's repository path, a file name template or a Go module path

pins.description: Pins qualifies refs.pins, the Artifacts a release of this one pins.

ArtifactSpec.description: ArtifactSpec is the fields of an Artifact.

since.description: a line id: from this line on

until.description: a line id: up to and including this line

Range.description: Range limits something to the Rancher lines from Since to Until, either of which may be left out.
